Package org.apache.hadoop.security.alias

Class LocalKeyStoreProvider

java.lang.Object
org.apache.hadoop.security.alias.CredentialProvider
org.apache.hadoop.security.alias.AbstractJavaKeyStoreProvider
org.apache.hadoop.security.alias.LocalKeyStoreProvider
Direct Known Subclasses:
LocalBouncyCastleFipsKeyStoreProvider, LocalJavaKeyStoreProvider
@Private public abstract class LocalKeyStoreProvider extends AbstractJavaKeyStoreProvider
CredentialProvider based on Java's KeyStore file format. The file may be stored only on the local filesystem using the following name mangling: localjceks://file/home/larry/creds.jceks -> file:///home/larry/creds.jceks
